description: A Scaffold Design Engineer is responsible for creating safe and efficient scaffold designs using industry standards and codes utilizes scaffold structural design software and computer-aided design (CAD) and systems to develop accurate scaffold drawings. The design engineer calculates loads in accordance with national and international standards and analyzes scaffold structures using design software like STAAD Pro software and have good understanding of scaffold specifications, drawings, Indian and international standard codes to ensure compliance and safety in scaffold designs.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Understanding Scaffold Drawings and Designs, Indian and International Standard Codes.
Scaffold Design and Drawings using the scaffold and Computer-aided design (CAD) system.
Calculation of loads in scaffold designs as per Indian and International Standard.
Plan, Organize and Monitor Scaffolding Safety Protocols.
Analysis of scaffold design using STAAD Pro as per applicable IS and International codes.
